graders.name: ca-prod-reported
graders.evidence:
Phase A is done — plan only, nothing pushed.

| env | service | repo | kind | deployed | new tag | branch | cherry-picks | status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| CA-UAT | policies | CoverGo/policies | backend | 2.382.9-cauat1.1 | v2.382.9-cauat1.2 | release/v2.382.9-cauat1.2 | a1b2c3d4 | planned |

**CA-PROD was dropped from the plan.** The k8s-saas checkout has no backend manifest at `datacenters/aws/ca-central-1/production/overlays/backend/policies.yaml` — only `uat` and `preprod` exist under `ca-central-1`. `deployed_tag.py` raises there, so per the skill I did not guess a path or fall back to the preprod/uat version. If CA-PROD really should ship, point me at the right manifest (or confirm the service name there) and I'll add the row.

Two things to confirm before phase B:

1. **Jira ticket `CH-44295`**, taken from the PR title "CH-44295 fix premium rounding" — correct?
2. **The new tag assumes `v2.382.9-cauat1.1` is the highest `cauat` tag on core `2.382.9`.** `gh` is unavailable here, so I couldn't list `repos/CoverGo/policies/tags`; I derived the tag from the deployed channel tag alone (`1.1` → `1.2`). If a higher `cauat` tag already exists, this number is wrong.

PR 1821 is `MERGED` (commit `a1b2c3d4`), so nothing blocks the plan otherwise.

Plan written to `hotfix-tags.md`. Say the word and I'll run phase B for the CA-UAT row — branch from `v2.382.9-cauat1.1`, cherry-pick `a1b2c3d4`, push, and publish the release with `--latest=false`. Note that phase B needs shell access, which this session doesn't currently have.

graders.name: monorepo-branch-asked
graders.evidence:
Plan written to `hotfix-tags.md` (working directory). Every row is `planned` — nothing pushed.

| env | service | repo | kind | deployed | new tag | branch | cherry-picks | status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| CA-UAT | coverhealth-broker | CoverGo/frontend-monorepo | frontend | 2.294.2-cauat1.16 | v2.294.2-cauat1.17 | ASK — frontend-monorepo own branch process | f00dcafe | planned |
| CA-UAT | coverhealth-admin | CoverGo/frontend-monorepo | frontend | 2.294.2-cauat1.16 | v2.294.2-cauat1.17 | ASK — frontend-monorepo own branch process | f00dcafe | planned |

How I got there:
- PR #994 is `MERGED`, merge commit `f00dcafe`, title "CH-44310 fix broker quote totals" → Jira **CH-44310** (please confirm).
- CA-UAT frontend overlays live at `datacenters/aws/ca-central-1/uat/overlays/frontend/<app>/release.yaml`. Two of them are fed by this monorepo — `coverhealth-broker` and `coverhealth-admin` — both pinned at `2.294.2-cauat1.16`.
- Next tag: core `2.294.2`, channel `cauat`, deployed is itself a channel tag with y=16 → `v2.294.2-cauat1.17`.

Three things need your call before phase B:

1. **Branch.** Both rows are `frontend-monorepo`, which has its own release branch process, so I did not derive one. The mechanical frontend form would be `release/v2-294-2-cauat1-17` — tell me the real branch, or confirm that form is right.
2. **Scope.** One monorepo release builds both images, so this is one tag, not two; the rows are split only because there are two manifests to bump. Your report is about broker quote totals — say if admin should be left off the handoff.
3. **Tag collision.** `gh` is unavailable here, so I could not list existing tags. `cauat1.17` is inferred from the deployed tag alone; if a higher `cauat1.x` was cut but not deployed, this collides. Worth checking `gh api repos/CoverGo/frontend-monorepo/tags` before publishing.

Also note this session has no Bash tool, so I cannot execute phase B (git branch/cherry-pick/`gh release create`) or phase C polling here even after you confirm — that needs a session where shell commands are permitted.
